question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word to fill in the blank.

__Allies__ have always come to his rescue in spite of his ____________ attempts to defame him.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. enemies’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"allies"** means people, groups, or nations that have joined together in an association for mutual benefit or to achieve a common aim. (मित्र)

 
 
• **Example: **The two nations were allies during the war, supporting each other with resources and strategic planning.
 
 
 
• **"Enemies"** refers to individuals or groups that are hostile to one another; adversaries or opponents. (दुश्मन)
 
 
• **Example: **Throughout history, these two nations have been bitter enemies, clashing repeatedly over territorial disputes.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'allies'** is **'enemies'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. enemies’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Fellows’ **(साथी): People who share a particular activity, quality, or condition.

 
 
• **Example:** He and his fellows worked tirelessly to ensure the success of the project.
 
 
 
• **Scholars’ **(विद्वान): People who are highly educated or have an aptitude for study.
 
 
• **Example: **The scholars gathered at the conference to discuss the latest research findings.
 
 
 
• **Buddies’** (दोस्त): Informal term for friends.
 
 
• **Example:** He and his childhood buddies have stayed in touch over the years, meeting up whenever they can.
